{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Identify refunded orders in the converted group
refunded_in_converted = converted_df[converted_df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Exclude refunded orders from the converted group to get true conversions
true_converted = converted_df[converted_df['status'] != 'refunded']

# Exclude customers with missing age (customer_age == -1)
valid_ages = true_converted[true_converted['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Total converted orders (converted == 1): {len(converted_df)}")
print(f"Refunded orders in converted group: {len(refunded_in_converted)}")
print(f"True converted (completed, not refunded): {len(true_converted)}")
print(f"Customer_age == -1 in true converted group: {true_converted['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")
print(f"Valid ages used (non -1): {len(valid_ages)}")
print(f"Mean age of valid ages: {mean_age}")

# Return the mean age value for submission
mean_age"}
